title: Fixed headed piles.
officialText:
For piles whose heads are designed to be fixed in the final structure, the results of the load
test shall be used to verify the input parameters used in the lateral load analysis. In the absence of specific project
requirements as determined by the engineer, the allowable load shall be the load that produces a gross lateral movement of ⅜
of an inch at the ground surface in the lateral load analysis.
